strategy.name: XAU_Breakout_Momentum_5m
strategy.rationale: XAU cheapest spread (0.011%). Breakout of 10-bar high/low with momentum confirms direction. Tight SL, modest TP for realistic scalp. Avoids weekend gaps via session filter.

history.analysis: 34.5% WR, PF 0.76, net -$40. Stops dominate (-$145). SMA cross too slow/whippy; 0 trades in 26h means conditions too strict for current bearish momentum. Spread costs ($32.79) eating winners. Need faster signals with momentum alignment.
mistakes: SMA 10/30 cross on 5m generates whipsaws in trending markets - 8 stop-outs vs entry direction confirms false cross entries
RSI>50 for longs in bearish momentum (RSI 35-41 now) means system goes silent exactly when bearish momentum dominates - over-filtered
TP 0.65% requires large moves on 5m BTC scalp; most winners exiting via time/trail at sub-TP levels shows TP too ambitious
Cooldown 40min + session 6-22UTC + SMA cross + RSI threshold = compounding filters that jointly fire rarely, causing 26h idle
changes: Replace SMA cross with breakout + momentum combo - faster signal, less lag for cron execution
Relax RSI thresholds to 45/55 from 50 to allow entries in trending momentum without dead-silence
Add XAU as primary scalp vehicle given 0.011% spread vs BTC 0.02% - edge is structurally larger per trade
Reduce TP to 0.35-0.45% and SL to 0.15% for tighter but more realistic scalp targets that actual price action delivers
Remove session filter or widen to 3-22UTC to capture Asian open volatility without losing signals

strategy.name: XAU_Breakout_Momentum_5m
strategy.rationale: XAU cheapest spread (0.011%). Breakout of 10-bar high/low with momentum confirms direction. Tight SL, modest TP for realistic scalp. Avoids weekend gaps via session filter.

history.analysis: PF 0.76, WR 34.5%: system loses. Stops dominate (-$145.8). Trail/time exits profitable. Spread ($32.79) ~82% of gross loss. R:R too tight for low WR. Mean-reversion against trend repeatedly stopped out.
mistakes: R:R 0.55/0.2 = 2.75 sounds good but realized avgW $6.38 vs avgL $4.41 = 1.45 actual - target never hit cleanly, trailing stop cuts winners short
SMA20 pull entry in trending market often enters mid-move continuation disguised as pullback, resulting in immediate stop-outs (see BTC long 65103->64966, 64164->64039)
XAU trades both losers: spread 0.011% sounds cheap but stopLossPct too tight relative to XAU volatility, gapped through stops
maxHoldMinutes 45 with trailingStopPct 0.28 conflicts - trailing fires at 0.28% retrace but time exit at 44m often captures only marginal winner (multiple 50m time exits with tiny PnL)
changes: Increase R:R minimum to 3:1 (TP/SL ratio) to make 34% WR breakeven or better after spread
Add breakout or momentum confirmation to avoid entering dead pullbacks that continue as trend resumptions against position
Reduce trailingStopPct to let winners run to TP more often, or widen TP to match realistic BTC 5m moves
Drop ETH entirely (8x spread cost destroys edge at scalping frequency)
Use XAU only with wider stops to survive gap risk, or avoid entirely at scalping timeframe

strategy.name: BTC_SMA_Cross_Trend_5m_HighRR
strategy.rationale: SMA 10/30 cross for trend entry with RSI confirmation. Higher TP:SL ratio (0.65/0.18 = 3.6:1) makes 34% WR profitable after spread. Momentum filter rejects weak crosses in chop.

history.analysis: WR 30% with PF 0.69 is deeply unprofitable. Stops cost $140 vs trails $55. Breakout on 1m chops in and out. $30 spread drag. Entries invalid by cron lag. Need trend confirmation, not raw breakout.
mistakes: 1m breakout fires on noise: by cron execution the breakout candle is stale, price reverts, stop hit immediately
30% WR with 0.55/0.22 TP/SL ratio should be profitable but stops dominate (-$140) indicating entries are wrong-side momentum chasing
XAU losses across v7/v8: multiple consecutive stops suggest no trend filter, trading into chop or counter-trend
trailingStop 0.15% too tight on 1m BTC, trails close winners early (avg win $7 vs potential), kills reward
changes: Switch to 5m candles - reduces cron-lag invalidation, fewer but higher-quality signals
Add sma_cross or price_vs_sma macro filter to ensure trading WITH trend not against it
Widen trailingStop to 0.25-0.30% so winners can breathe on 5m
Increase TP:SL ratio to at least 2.5:1 to make 30% WR profitable
Drop ETH entirely - 0.16% spread is 8x BTC, scalping it is spread suicide

strategy.name: BTC_TrendPull_5m_SMAFilter
strategy.rationale: 5m candles reduce stale-entry lag. SMA50 trend bias prevents counter-trend entries. Pull-to-SMA20 entry with RSI oversold/overbought gives mean-reversion in trend direction, better WR.

history.analysis: 27% WR with 0.65 PF means winners too rare and too small vs losers. Stop exits dominate (-$138). R:R 1.75:1 insufficient given low WR. Spread ($28) is ~50% of gross losses. ETH avoided correctly.
mistakes: R:R ratio (0.65/0.28 = 2.3:1 nominal) not materializing - actual avg W/L = 1.76:1, suggesting stops hit before TP, meaning stopLossPct too tight relative to 5m noise
15-bar breakout on 5m generates false breaks in ranging BTC - 6 of last 8 BTC trades stopped out, breakout direction immediately reversed
cooldown 35min after stop means missing recovery moves but also insufficient to reset market regime
trailingStopPct 0.2% too tight on BTC 5m - trail exits captured only $52 total while stops bled $138, trail locks in too little profit
changes: Drop ETH entirely - 0.16% spread requires 8x the move of BTC to break even, incompatible with scalping
Widen stopLossPct and increase takeProfitPct to maintain R:R but survive initial noise
Add session filter to avoid known low-volume windows
Replace pure breakout with trend-confirmed mean-reversion or stronger momentum filter to improve WR above 40%
Reduce riskPerTradePct from 0.3% to 0.25% to preserve capital during further drawdown

strategy.name: BTC_Breakout_1m_HighMomentum
strategy.rationale: 1m with tight N-bar breakout captures fast momentum bursts. Higher trade frequency improves statistical significance. Strict RSI+momentum double filter raises WR on low-spread BTC.

history.analysis: PF 0.67, WR 27.5%: mean-reversion fades keep stopping out. Stops eat $122, trails only $47. Spread $24.78 on 40 trades signals overtrading. Time exits profitable net—holds too short on winners, stops too tight on losers.
mistakes: Stop exits dominate losses (-$122): stop placement at 0.22% too tight for XAU 5m noise, triggering before mean-reversion completes
WR 27.5% is far below the ~45%+ needed for 2:1 R:R to be profitable—strategy needs either higher WR or better R:R, not both mediocre
ETH avoided (correct given 0.16% cost) but BTC scalps on 5m showed repeated time-exits near breakeven, indicating no real edge there either
Cooldown 20min too short—back-to-back stops visible in journal (3 consecutive XAU stops), compounding losses in trending moves
changes: Abandon pure mean-reversion fades—replace with trend-confirmation breakout or momentum entries that align with short-term trend
Widen stop to 0.35%+ on XAU to survive noise; raise TP to 0.70%+ for minimum 2:1 after spread; accept fewer but cleaner trades
Extend cooldown to 45min and maxHoldMinutes to 90 to let winners breathe; time-exit pnl was positive suggesting more patience rewarded

strategy.name: BTC_Breakout_5m_LowSpread
strategy.rationale: BTC 0.02% spread enables breakout scalping 24/7. 15-bar breakout with RSI trend filter and momentum avoids false breaks; wider hold captures real moves past noise.

history.analysis: WR 28% with PF 0.69 is deeply unprofitable. Stops dominate losses (-$119). Trail exits are only profitable exit type. Spread consumed $24 on tiny winners. 1m lag on cron makes entries stale; signals fire into exhausted moves.
mistakes: Stop exits catastrophic (-$118.73 total): stop distance 0.15% too tight for 1m XAU noise, repeatedly stopped before move develops
Win rate 28% far too low for 1:1.4 R:R - need either higher WR or better R:R to overcome spread drag
Trailing stop at 0.12% locks in near-zero wins (e.g. -0.04, +0.94) while spread eats the gain
1m candle + cron lag = entering on stale breakouts already partially played out, especially XAU London open spikes
changes: Widen stop to 0.25-0.3% to survive 1m noise and reduce stop-exit dominance
Raise TP to 0.6-0.8% so reward clearly exceeds spread multiple times over
Move to 5m candles to reduce cron-lag staleness and filter microstructure noise
Drop ETH entirely; focus XAU (cheapest) and BTC (second cheapest)
Replace SMA cross entry with momentum + bollinger squeeze to catch real breakouts not lagged crosses

strategy.name: XAU_RSI_Mean_Reversion_5m
strategy.rationale: Opposite philosophy to trend: fade extreme RSI within active session using Bollinger band touch. Shorter hold, lower TP but very defined risk. Catches frequent intraday overextensions in XAU cheaply.

history.analysis: PF 0.75, WR 29.7%: system loses. Trail exits profitable but stops dominate losses. Spread $23.49 on $-32.94 net means spread alone nearly explains losses. BTC time-exits mostly losers; XAU stop exits large negative outliers.
mistakes: Win rate 29.7% requires R:R >2.4 to break even; current TP/SL ~2.2 is insufficient - math never works
BTC spread 0.02% still too costly for these tiny 0.25% stop scalps - net edge consumed by spread on most trades
SMA9/21 cross on 5m is a lagging entry - price has already moved, entry chases and stops trigger before target
maxHoldMinutes 60-65 exits profitable XAU runners early (4150->4173 was held to time, not trailed properly) and also exits losing BTC at time with big losses
changes: Raise R:R to minimum 3:1 (TP/SL ratio) so 30% WR is mathematically profitable
Tighten SL to 0.18% but push TP to 0.55%+ giving true 3:1 after spread
Add breakout confirmation so entry is on momentum already established, reducing false entries
Extend maxHoldMinutes to 120 to let winners run via trail rather than time-killing them
Raise cooldown to 60min to avoid regime-repeat losses

strategy.name: XAU_Trend_London_1m
strategy.rationale: 1m candles tighten entry lag vs cron. London open only for strongest directional flow. SMA cross plus breakout plus ATR spike catches genuine intraday trend ignition early.

history.analysis: WR 24% with PF 0.71: too many small losers eating spread. Stops hit 71% of net loss. Time exits profitable but tiny. ETH avoided (wise). Breakout signals firing in chop—entries don't stay valid long enough.
mistakes: Breakout on 5m fires in ranging markets: 6 of last 7 BTC trades lost small, all time-exits—classic chop signal failure paying spread repeatedly
Stop at 0.4% vs TP at 0.9% gives ~2.25R but WR needs 31%+ to break even; actual WR 24% is well below that threshold
20-bar breakout on 5m is only 100 minutes of history—too short, generates false breakouts in sideways BTC action
Trailing stop 0.35% too tight for BTC 5m ATR, getting stopped out of winning trades early (trail PnL only $42 on 3 trades)
changes: Drop ETH permanently—8x spread cost makes scalping mathematically hostile at this account size
Raise breakout period to filter noise, or replace breakout with trend-following SMA cross to reduce false signals
Widen stop, tighten TP ratio to ~1.5R minimum but require higher WR setup, OR keep 2R but add stricter entry filters to raise WR above 35%
Add session filter to concentrate BTC trades in high-liquidity UTC 08-22 window
Reduce riskPerTradePct to 0.4% to slow drawdown while system is unproven

strategy.name: XAU_Trend_Session
strategy.rationale: XAU cheapest spread (0.011%). SMA cross trend filter on active London/NY session only avoids weekend gaps and low-volume chop. Momentum confirmation raises WR.
